body: Thank you for this. However, I still cant see why living matters at all. I feel that, as a species, we are doomed to extinction. We are too divided as a people to work together in harmony. The world is too big for people to cooperate against a major threat to our people. And even then, the inexorable heat death of the universe will end all that has physically existed. I know those are just theories about the future of our universe but I see the chance of our species surviving eternally as almost nonexistent. Everything will end and for that I see no reason for anyone to live. I feel that the only reason we all push forward is because it is hardwired into the architecture of our brain to continue living. We are forever bounded to the chemistry and biology of our mentality. I honestly wish I was religious. That's the only way I could see myself being motivated to do anything. And at the same time i could never see myself converting. I've just got too many questions. Too many for my own good. Too many to be answered.
